title: Acquirer: Sydney Credit Union Ltd; Target: Parkes District Credit Union Limited

body_sections.Summary: By letter dated 5 July 2004, APRA informed the ACCC of the proposed transfer of the entire business of Parkes District Credit Union Limited to Sydney Credit Union Limited.
body_sections.Market definition: For competition assessment purposes, the relevant product market in this instance was treated as a broadly defined market for financial services.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC's concentration thresholds are not crossed.
